typePromptPrefixes.dish: Dish sprite rule: this is a grid-footprint food sprite, not an inventory prop icon. One grid cell is 512 by 512 pixels. Place the whole final rectangular canvas on a SOLID FLAT UNIFORM bright magenta background, pure #FF00FF, for local alpha removal. Empty footprint cells must stay pure #FF00FF. Do not draw grid lines, cell borders, rectangles, guides, or checkerboards. Do not add cast shadows outside occupied food cells; the game renders a separate runtime contact shadow.
